states.summary: Session subsystem not yet initialized; no auth structure allocated.

states.summary: Response received and HMAC verified; parameters decrypted if ENCRYPT attribute set.

evidence.reason: tpm_buf_check_hmac_response() verifies rpHash, HMAC, and optionally decrypts parameters.

states.summary: Session terminated; session handle flushed, auth structure freed or reset.
